title: Keith R. Edwards
vital_facts: Born March 16, 1942, in Boulder City, Nevada
Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult
Married Judith Lee Higgins, June 20, 1964, St. George Utah Temple; seven children
Bachelor's in Political Science, BYU (1966); Juris Dctorate, University of Utah (1969)
Senior partner in Edwards, Hale, Sturman and Cushing (merged in 2005 with Wilson and Elser.)
Temple Ordinance Worker, Assistant Recorder at Las Vegas Nevada Temple; Seminary Teacher; Bishop; Regional Welfare Agent; Stake High Councilor; Stake President, Area Seventy
President of the Zimbabwe Harare Mission, 2000-03
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
